scope: Explain a user-valued save increment, the role–goal–benefit sentence and supporting acceptance conversation. Exclude full SRS structure and mandatory Scrum practice. Distinguish: A story is not a UI task or the whole use case.

Describe actor goal, preconditions, main scenario and extensions for persistent saving. Exclude exhaustive UI wireframes, database schema and quality-requirement specifications. Distinguish: A use-case diagram is not the complete behavioral narrative.

Explain situation, motivation and expected outcome using an interrupted commute. Exclude complete jobs-to-be-done theory and claims that roles never matter. Distinguish: A job story is not an acceptance test or a job vacancy description.

titles.ja: レイヤードアーキテクチャ

scope: Explain logical presentation, application and data layers with explicit allowed dependencies. Exclude infrastructure tier sizing and distributed-service decomposition. Distinguish: A layer is not a server tier; folder names do not enforce boundaries.

titles.ja: ヘキサゴナルアーキテクチャ

scope: Explain application ports and driving/driven adapters around the save use case. Exclude six mandatory components and microservice deployment recipes. Distinguish: The hexagon is a visual convention, not a fixed port count.

titles.ja: クリーンアーキテクチャ

scope: Explain inward source dependencies, use-case orchestration, entities and boundary data for saving. Exclude mandatory four-folder recipes and framework implementation tutorials. Distinguish: Runtime calls can travel outward through interfaces while source dependencies remain inward.

Explain one deployable application containing catalog, library and billing with internal calls. Exclude claims that monolith means no modules, one physical machine or no scaling. Distinguish: Multiple replicas of one artifact remain a monolithic deployment model.

Explain explicit module APIs and owned internals within a shared application artifact. Exclude promises of effortless future service extraction and prescribed module frameworks. Distinguish: Directories alone do not enforce a module contract; this remains a monolith.

Explain independently deployable capability services, explicit contracts and service-owned data. Exclude universal service sizes, automatic scalability and vendor orchestration tutorials. Distinguish: A service is not merely a class named Service; distributed deployment alone does not create independence.

Explain position-based sequence operations while leaving physical storage open. Exclude uI list layouts and language-specific collection performance rankings. Distinguish: List is not synonymous with linked list or array.

Explain uniqueness under equality and membership queries independent of iteration order. Exclude claims that all sets are unordered in every language or always use hashing. Distinguish: Set iteration order and mathematical membership are different concerns.

Explain key-to-value association, replacement under the same key and explicit missing lookup. Exclude geographic maps, functional map operations and hash-table internals. Distinguish: Keys are unique; values need not be.

Explain contiguous backing slots, indexed reads, length/capacity and insertion shifts. Exclude claims about all JavaScript arrays and real cache-performance measurements. Distinguish: A dynamic array wraps a fixed backing store; list is the abstract interface.

Explain doubly linked nodes, traversal, head/tail and insertion using known adjacent references. Exclude allocator internals and blanket claims that linked insertion is always faster. Distinguish: Constant-time relinking excludes finding the location.

Explain push, peek and pop under LIFO, including empty state. Exclude call-stack implementation and arbitrary-item priority selection. Distinguish: Storage location does not define LIFO; the removal contract does.

Explain enqueue and dequeue at different ends with explicit empty handling. Exclude distributed delivery guarantees and concurrent completion-order promises. Distinguish: FIFO dequeue order is not necessarily processing completion order.

Explain priority-based removal with a chosen comparator and tie rule. Exclude heap implementation tutorials and universal stable-tie guarantees. Distinguish: Priority queues need not iterate in sorted order or preserve equal-priority arrival order automatically.

Explain content-oriented component rendering and optional interactive islands in a static build. Exclude server-adapter setup, latest-version ranking and benchmark promises. Distinguish: Astro is not limited to static output; an island is not a separate website.

Explain Hugo content, templates and generated static assets using the three-article site. Exclude comparative speed numbers, plugin catalogs and Go application development. Distinguish: Hugo is written in Go; content authors do not need to turn articles into Go programs.

Explain the Ruby-based Jekyll build workflow and Markdown/template inputs. Exclude hosted-platform plugin restrictions and Ruby version installation advice. Distinguish: Jekyll generation and GitHub Pages hosting are distinct choices.

Explain components, props, event handlers and state using Save. Exclude full application frameworks, router selection and optimization recipes. Distinguish: A state update requests rendering; mutating an ordinary local variable is not the same mechanism.

Explain declarative template bindings and reactive state in a single-file component. Exclude router setup, exhaustive API-style comparison and performance rankings. Distinguish: Single-file component is an authoring format, not one browser network file.

Explain compiled declarative components and a Save state transition. Exclude comparative bundle claims, framework routing and legacy-to-current migration. Distinguish: Svelte and SvelteKit have different scopes; compiler use does not mean zero runtime work.

Explain node trees, saved scenes, instances and the main-scene entry point. Exclude engine benchmarking, platform export guarantees and licensing terms. Distinguish: A saved scene is reusable composition, not only a full game level.

Explain GameObject containers, attached components and scene composition for a collectible. Exclude asset-store comparisons, pricing, version selection and platform export guarantees. Distinguish: A GameObject name alone does not supply gameplay behavior.

Explain Actors in a level and a reusable Blueprint class with component composition. Exclude rendering feature comparisons, royalties and supported-platform promises. Distinguish: Blueprint graphs describe behavior; they are not merely decorative flowcharts.

Explain serving HTML, CSS and JavaScript files and separating per-user writes into an API. Exclude provider plans, caching guarantees and assertions that static means noninteractive. Distinguish: Browser-side interaction is possible; private persistence is not supplied by static files.

Explain a listening process, request handlers, durable storage and process supervision as a separate operational concern. Exclude uptime guarantees, provider prices and production server configuration. Distinguish: A process that normally stays running can restart; memory is not durable storage.

Explain event-triggered function execution and external durable state with provider-bounded behavior. Exclude universal cold-start durations, limits, prices and all serverless compute variants. Distinguish: Serverless means managed infrastructure, not absent servers or automatic business correctness.

Explain replica replacement, readiness and capacity assumptions through a four-replica pool. Exclude zero-downtime guarantees and universal orchestration defaults. Distinguish: Progressive replacement alone is not canary analysis.

Explain parallel old/new environments, traffic switch and bounded switch-back. Exclude guaranteed instant recovery and database rollback automation. Distinguish: Environment switch is not necessarily gradual exposure.

Explain a small v2 cohort, a v1 control and a predetermined evaluation rule. Exclude universal safe percentages and treating synthetic counts as production measurements. Distinguish: A canary is release risk evaluation, not automatically a product A/B experiment.

Explain vertically stacked page regions and constrained text width. Exclude claims that single column requires edge-to-edge text or forbids nested grids. Distinguish: Page-region layout and item-list arrangement are separate axes.

Explain a sidebar and main region with a documented narrow-screen collapse. Exclude universal sidebar widths and CSS newspaper text flow. Distinguish: Two page regions are not two streams of fragmented paragraph text.

Explain three or more independent regions with a responsive stacking plan. Exclude cSS multicol text fragmentation and dense dashboard implementation. Distinguish: Independent regions differ from one paragraph flowing across columns [multicol].

Explain a vertical series of item rows with stable field positions and order. Exclude list data-structure internals and claims that every list is text-only. Distinguish: A visual list can be stored in any suitable collection and placed inside a page column.

Explain equal-width tracks and aligned row boundaries while preserving complete card content. Exclude claims that all grids have fixed height or require cropped images. Distinguish: Uniform grid is an arrangement pattern, not every use of CSS Grid.

Explain vertical-gap packing using a deterministic two-column illustrative algorithm. Exclude native CSS support promises and claims that packing always improves usability. Distinguish: A masonry pattern is not the same thing as the Masonry library or ordinary aligned grid rows.

Explain deliberately unadorned web surfaces, visible structure and conventional controls through a reading card. Exclude architectural history, shock effects and deliberate navigation breakage. Distinguish: Antidesign is not required; a sparse page is not automatically brutalist.

Explain thick outlines, hard offset shadows and expressive color while preserving reading hierarchy. Exclude universal rules, origin ownership and guaranteed engagement. Distinguish: Hard shadows differ from soft extrusion; raw and colorful are not synonyms.

Explain translucent layers and backdrop blur over calm and busy backgrounds. Exclude platform material APIs, rendering benchmarks and claims that blur ensures contrast. Distinguish: Backdrop blur differs from blurring text and from opaque extrusion.

Explain paired highlights and shadows on a same-tone surface, separating decoration from control state. Exclude inventor claims, trend forecasts and banking-app usability claims. Distinguish: Soft extrusion differs from transparency and hard offset shadows.

titles.ja: スキューモーフィズム

scope: Explain a paper index-card and bookmark metaphor with an explicit digital Save label. Exclude photorealistic rendering and universally familiar objects. Distinguish: Realistic texture alone is not a functional metaphor; metaphors can be drawn flat.

Explain two-dimensional surface treatment with preserved action signifiers. Exclude claims that flat means minimalist, faster or automatically accessible. Distinguish: Density is independent of depth; flat icons can retain object metaphors.

Explain task-based reduction of decoration and redundancy while retaining title, summary, metadata and Save. Exclude lifestyle minimalism, mandatory monochrome and universal element counts. Distinguish: Content selection is different from flat surface treatment.

Explain serif stroke endings with magnified letters and multilingual fallback caveats. Exclude named font recommendations and universal readability superiority. Distinguish: Serif describes shape, not fixed/proportional width or a universal CJK category.

Explain generally unadorned stroke endings, variation within sans forms and multilingual coverage. Exclude claims that sans is always modern, more readable or monospaced. Distinguish: No serifs does not mean no shape variation or guaranteed clarity.

Explain handwritten construction and possible joining through a short heading specimen. Exclude programming scripts, Unicode script taxonomy and decorative-font product lists. Distinguish: CSS cursive is a nearby generic category; this editorial label is not an exact universal mapping.

Explain varying advance widths and distinguish text spacing from digit alignment. Exclude font-product recommendations and measured reading-speed claims. Distinguish: Proportional text can have tabular digits; glyph outline width is not its full advance.

Explain equal advances for a defined glyph set with mixed-script and fallback limitations. Exclude claims that every Unicode character occupies one terminal cell and named font rankings. Distinguish: Monospaced glyphs can have different ink widths; terminal cells are another model.

Explain customer-funded access independently of billing schedule and legal seller arrangement. Exclude revenue forecasts, checkout integration and universal tax rules. Distinguish: Direct customer revenue is not synonymous with the direct-seller responsibility model.

Explain advertiser-funded placements with a publisher/network example and competing incentives. Exclude guaranteed CPM, tracking consent advice and ad-network eligibility. Distinguish: An ad-funded site may also charge readers; a direct sponsorship is not necessarily auction advertising.

Explain support for a public project, defined sponsor benefits and one-time/recurring options. Exclude universal charitable status, tax deduction and platform fee claims. Distinguish: Supporter funding may include benefits; commercial placement sponsorship can overlap advertising.

Explain a single charge and separately specified entitlement, support and upgrade terms. Exclude lifetime-service promises, real prices and refund law. Distinguish: One payment does not inherently mean perpetual updates or permanent hosted service.

Explain billing intervals, recurring access and the need for failed-payment/cancellation policies. Exclude provider-specific proration, cancellation law and real plan prices. Distinguish: Subscription is not necessarily flat-rate; usage charges can recur within it.

Explain billable unit, metering, aggregation and a transparent amount calculation. Exclude provider metering APIs, real prices and complex tier formulas. Distinguish: Usage billing can be collected on a recurring subscription schedule.

Explain the business as seller in a bounded processor arrangement and separate payment execution from transaction responsibility. Exclude country-specific tax advice, provider fees and claims about every product of a named provider. Distinguish: Direct seller concerns responsibility; customer direct payment concerns revenue source.

Explain a contracted MoR as seller for covered transactions, settlement to the product business and retained product obligations. Exclude universal compliance guarantees, exact tax coverage and provider fee comparisons. Distinguish: MoR is a transaction role, not automatically the product creator or provider of every support obligation.

Liquid Glass uses a dynamic, transparent navigation layer above content. This web study illustrates its visual cues, not Apple’s native rendering. Preserve the common project workspace and all basic actions.

Material 3 Expressive directs attention with color, shape, size, and motion. This authored study uses large task controls and varied curves. Preserve the common project workspace and all basic actions.

Tactile collage layers paper, tape, and annotations. This editorial category groups handmade cues discussed in Canva’s 2026 trends; it does not date their invention. Preserve the common project workspace and all basic actions.

Retro digital borrows early desktop windows and pixel ornaments. This editorial category relates to Canva’s 2026 early-computing trend, not a claim of invention in 2026. Preserve the common project workspace and all basic actions.

titles.ja: アフィリエイト手数料

scope: Affiliate revenue rewards qualifying referrals to another seller. A click alone does not necessarily qualify, and eligibility follows the particular program agreement. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Transaction fee revenue comes from facilitating trades between buyers and sellers. It differs from referring a visitor elsewhere and does not itself determine the contractual seller. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Prepaid credits collect payment before usage and reduce a balance as units are consumed. Credit value, expiry and eligible uses depend on the offer. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Flat-rate pricing sets one amount for a defined package and period. Included features and limits still matter; a fixed price does not promise unlimited service. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Per-seat pricing multiplies a seat count by a unit price. Specify which seats are billable; activity and usage are different measurements. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Feature-tiered pricing offers packages with different capabilities. These tiers describe what customers receive, unlike quantity tiers that change a unit price. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Volume pricing uses the final quantity tier to price every unit. Crossing a threshold can reduce the total, unlike graduated pricing. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Graduated pricing prices units within each tier separately and adds the subtotals. Reaching a cheaper tier does not reprice earlier units. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Base fee plus overage combines a fixed charge with included usage and a rate for excess units. The base remains payable even with no usage. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Freemium keeps a usable free offering while charging for enhancements. The boundary is functionality or allowance, rather than a temporary evaluation deadline. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

A free trial grants temporary access to evaluate a paid offering. Its duration and conversion policy must be stated; automatic charging is not inherent to every trial. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

A consumable purchase supplies units that are depleted through use and can be bought again. It differs from a non-consumable feature entitlement. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

A non-consumable purchase unlocks an entitlement that does not expire or decrease through use. It differs from consumable units and recurring subscriptions. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Banner ads occupy a bounded region while the main app remains visible. Format describes placement, not a guaranteed revenue level or targeting method. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

titles.ja: インタースティシャル広告

scope: Interstitial ads cover the app at a natural break, such as completing a level. They interrupt the screen flow, unlike a banner beside content. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.

Rewarded ads offer a disclosed benefit for completing a specified action. Google requires clear reward conditions and opt-in for this format, with dismissal available. Exclude real prices, revenue forecasts and country-specific tax advice.
